description:
Your dev computer, from your phone.

Pocket Dev is a free, open-source project by Ani (anisirji). Use your computer’s terminals, Claude Code, Codex, Git and files through your phone’s browser. Your work runs on your own computer, using your existing coding-agent accounts.

This channel shares real product demos, setup tutorials and AFK — fictional stories about developers away from their desks.

Same Wi-Fi works by default. Away-from-home access is optional and needs setup; the computer must stay on and awake. No phone app or Pocket Dev cloud account required.

Source and setup: https://github.com/anisirji/pocket-dev
Guide: https://www.theani.me/work/pocket-dev/docs
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/afk_pocket_dev/
Set up with AI: https://www.theani.me/work/pocket-dev/prompts
